    About This Project

    🎯

    What it does

    Takes lifestyle and social-media inputs and returns a predicted mental health score.

    🤖

    Machine learning

    A trained ML model, loaded from a saved file, produces the prediction.

    ⚡

    FastAPI backend

    FastAPI exposes the model through a /predict endpoint and validates every request.

    🌐

    Vanilla JS frontend

    Plain JavaScript uses fetch() to send your inputs to the API and display the result.
